summary:
Implementation plan for PS-003 Federated Traffic-Flow Forecasting:
1. Adding smooth background fade transition animation to the 'MAE: X km/h' badge in the header whenever MAE updates after a simulation round completes.
2. Enriching traffic flow feature engineering with multi-horizon historical lags, cyclical time-of-day features, weekday/weekend indicators, and peak-hour congestion shockwave flags.
3. Preserving all existing interactive panels while integrating missing PS-003 deliverables: interactive FedAvg pseudocode viewer modal, chronological train/val/test data leakage audit badges, and 3-seed statistical robustness matrix.
4. Performing feature engineering code hygiene and cleanup to ensure full compliance with PS-003 constraints without breaking functionality.
